topics.name: Mobile Agentic AI
topics.description: Papers, benchmarks, datasets, and open-source systems for agents that perceive, reason, and act on smartphones and mobile GUIs.

resources.title: AppAgent: Multimodal Agents as Smartphone Users
resources.summary: Learns to operate unfamiliar smartphone apps through autonomous exploration or human demonstrations.

resources.title: Empowering LLM to Use Smartphone for Intelligent Task Automation
resources.summary: AutoDroid combines Android UI exploration, app memory, and LLM planning for task automation.

resources.title: Mobile-Agent: Autonomous Multi-Modal Mobile Device Agent with Visual Perception
resources.summary: Vision-centric mobile operation without relying on app XML or system metadata.

resources.title: Mobile-Agent-v2: Mobile Device Operation Assistant with Effective Navigation via Multi-Agent Collaboration
resources.summary: Separates planning, decision, reflection, and progress memory for long mobile tasks.

resources.title: Advancing Mobile GUI Agents: A Verifier-Driven Approach to Practical Deployment
resources.summary: Uses an LLM verifier to rank candidate actions, with progress preferences and deployment-oriented latency.

resources.title: MobileUse: A GUI Agent with Hierarchical Reflection for Autonomous Mobile Operation
resources.summary: Combines hierarchical reflection and proactive exploration for long-horizon Android operation.

resources.title: Mobile-Agent-v3: Foundamental Agents for GUI Automation
resources.summary: Pairs GUI-Owl foundation models with planning, progress management, reflection, memory, and scalable environment RL.

resources.title: Agent-SAMA: State-Aware Mobile Assistant
resources.summary: Studies state-aware assistance and specialized agent roles for mobile interaction.

resources.title: EcoAgent: An Efficient Device-Cloud Collaborative Multi-Agent Framework for Mobile Automation
resources.summary: Explores device-cloud collaboration and efficient multi-agent routing for mobile automation.

resources.title: Mobile-Agent-RAG: Driving Smart Multi-Agent Coordination with Contextual Knowledge Empowerment for Long-Horizon Mobile Automation
resources.summary: Uses retrieval-augmented contextual knowledge to coordinate agents over long mobile workflows.

resources.title: K²-Agent: Co-Evolving Know-What and Know-How for Hierarchical Mobile Device Control
resources.summary: Co-evolves task knowledge and procedural skills for hierarchical mobile control.

resources.title: M²-Miner: Multi-Agent Enhanced MCTS for Mobile GUI Agent Data Mining
resources.summary: Combines multi-agent roles and Monte Carlo tree search to mine mobile GUI trajectories.

resources.title: AndroidWorld: A Dynamic Benchmarking Environment for Autonomous Agents
resources.summary: A reproducible Android environment with dynamically instantiated tasks and executable success checks.

resources.title: B-MoCA: Benchmarking Mobile Device Control Agents across Diverse Configurations
resources.summary: Randomizes layouts, languages, wallpapers, and device types to test configuration generalization.

resources.title: LlamaTouch: A Faithful and Scalable Testbed for Mobile UI Task Automation
resources.summary: Evaluates task completion through essential application and system states on real mobile environments.

resources.title: Mobile-Bench: An Evaluation Benchmark for LLM-based Mobile Agents
resources.summary: Covers single- and multi-app tasks and introduces process checkpoints for planning evaluation.

resources.title: AndroidLab: Training and Systematic Benchmarking of Android Autonomous Agents
resources.summary: Provides Android environments, 138 tasks, unified action spaces, and Android Instruct training data.

resources.title: A3: Android Agent Arena for Mobile GUI Agents
resources.summary: Evaluates mobile agents on real-world third-party apps and practical online tasks.

resources.title: MobileWorld: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents in Agent-User Interactive and MCP-Augmented Environments
resources.summary: Adds long cross-app tasks, user interaction, MCP calls, and functional verification beyond AndroidWorld.

resources.title: FingerTip 20K: A Benchmark for Proactive and Personalized Mobile LLM Agents
resources.summary: Targets proactive and personalized behavior rather than instruction-only mobile control.

resources.title: MobileSafetyBench: Evaluating Safety of Autonomous Agents in Mobile Device Control
resources.summary: Evaluates safety risks arising from autonomous control of mobile devices.

resources.title: GhostEI-Bench: Do Mobile Agents Resist Environmental Injection in Dynamic On-Device Environments?
resources.summary: Studies environmental injection attacks in dynamic on-device mobile settings.

resources.title: Mobile-Agent family
resources.summary: Official implementation hub for Mobile-Agent, Mobile-Agent-v2/v3, GUI-Owl, data, models, and evaluations.

resources.title: MobileBench-OL
resources.summary: Runs and evaluates multiple mobile GUI agents on physical Android devices with rule and XPath checks.

resources.title: UFO MobileAgent
resources.summary: Android task executor using UI controls, screenshots, app management, MCP, and a finite-state control loop.

resources.title: UI-Venus
resources.summary: Screenshot-only native UI agent for grounding and navigation, evaluated on AndroidWorld and AndroidLab.

resources.title: UI-TARS
resources.summary: Native end-to-end GUI agent models spanning perception, action modeling, reasoning, and reflective traces.

resources.title: OS-Atlas
resources.summary: Foundation action model and data pipeline for generalist GUI agents.

resources.title: ShowUI
resources.summary: Open end-to-end vision-language-action model for GUI grounding and computer use.

resources.title: Aguvis
resources.summary: Unified pure-vision agents for autonomous GUI interaction across platforms.

resources.title: GUI Agents Paper List
resources.summary: A broad GUI-agent bibliography with a dedicated mobile environment section.

resources.title: Awesome GUI Agents
resources.summary: Curated GUI-agent resources, tools, frameworks, benchmarks, and mobile papers.
